scope: Current prototype CSS only. No product source, prototype state, user data, credentials or historical acceptance evidence changed.

method.parser: Existing repository dependency postcss 8.5.26; no dependency added.
method.predicate: Remove only a selector branch requiring a complete hub-* or set-* class name absent as a literal anywhere in the reference corpus. Inspect dynamic className expressions to exclude construction of these prefixes. Do not infer obsolete status from dates or V2 names.
method.negation_guard: Refuse automatic deletion if a potentially absent hub-/set- class occurs inside a :not() condition.
method.shared_rules: Keep live branches of comma-separated selectors unchanged; remove a full rule only when all branches are unreachable; remove an at-rule only after it has no children.
method.read_only_checks: All 106 current JS/JSX/CSS source files reachable from main.jsx. No exact duplicate source files. All five public SVGs referenced. No current source file exceeds 1500 lines. No production src/src-tauri/src/scripts/config imports of the prototype found.
method.evidence_limit: Source files were untracked. Complete pre-edit CSS snapshots/hashes were not saved. Counts and original line ranges come from tool output captured before/during deletion. One of 392 deleted selector branches was counted and localized but its verbatim selector was not retained; that entry is explicitly null rather than guessed.

removed_selectors.note: Additional complete rule deleted by the final all-class scan. The initial dry run recorded only selectors starting with hub-/set-; this rule required hub-radio later in its selector. Its original selector text was not retained, so it is not reconstructed.

verification.tests_and_build: owned by parent task; not duplicated here
ui_smoke_required: Agent directory, first-use three-step setup and completed Agent management
API list/add/edit and inline error state

read_only_follow_up.status: Authorized follow-up completed; exact records and hashes are under additional_style_cleanup.

method.candidate_source: The 83 previously inventoried selector branches only; no other selectors considered.

expressions.expression: { modelDraft.model === m && modelDraft.source === "沿用已有设置" ? "selected" : "" }

dynamic_class_review.conclusion: Reviewed all dynamic className expressions. These expressions append fixed state classes, use literal choices or forward declared component props; none constructs the absent candidate class names. Full literal reference scan also covers test fixtures and mock data.

method.preservation: Keep all current selector branches and all declarations byte-for-byte within their rules; compare the ordered selector/declaration sequence before and after excluding only deleted branches.
